description: This file contains unit tests for the DefaultNamespacedEntityId class, a part of the Eclipse Ditto project. It tests various aspects such as immutability, equality, string representation, validation of namespace and name, maximum length constraints, handling of placeholders, and special character handling in namespace and name identifiers.

classes.name: DefaultNamespacedEntityIdTest
classes.description: A JUnit test class that verifies the correct behavior of the DefaultNamespacedEntityId implementation, including validation, equality, immutability, and string representation.

methods.name: testImmutability
methods.description: Verifies that instances of DefaultNamespacedEntityId are immutable.

methods.name: testEqualsAndHashcode
methods.description: Checks the correctness of equals and hashCode methods using the EqualsVerifier library.

methods.name: fromNameHasEmptyNamespace
methods.description: Validates creating a NamespacedEntityId with only a name assigns an empty string to namespace.

methods.name: defaultNamespacedEntityIdFromDefaultNamespacedEntityIdIsSameInstance
methods.description: Checks that creating a NamespacedEntityId from an existing instance returns the same instance (identity).

methods.name: defaultNamespacedEntityIdFromNamespacedEntityIdSkipsValidation
methods.description: Tests that copying an existing NamespacedEntityId bypasses validation, allowing invalid data.

methods.name: canHaveMaximumLengthOf256Characters
methods.description: Ensures IDs can be created with maximum allowed length of 256 characters.

methods.name: cannotHaveMoreThan256Characters
methods.description: Verifies creation fails if the ID exceeds maximum length of 256 characters.

methods.name: nullId
methods.description: Checks that passing null to create an ID throws the appropriate exception.

methods.name: nullName
methods.description: Checks that null name validation throws the exception.

methods.name: nullNamespace
methods.description: Checks that null namespace validation throws the exception.

methods.name: testConstantsAreValid
methods.description: Verifies predefined constants used for IDs are valid.

methods.name: toStringConcatenatesNamespaceAndName
methods.description: Ensures the toString method properly concatenates namespace and name.

methods.name: placeholderIsPlaceholder
methods.description: Verifies that a dummy or placeholder ID is recognized as such.

methods.name: manuallyCreatedPlaceholderIsPlaceholder
methods.description: Checks that manually created placeholder IDs are recognized as placeholders.

methods.name: valid
methods.description: Validates a regular, valid ID with specific namespace and name.

methods.name: nameStartsWithColon
methods.description: Ensures names starting with colon are permitted.

methods.name: emptyNamespace
methods.description: Verifies an empty namespace with a valid name is valid.

methods.name: onlyColons
methods.description: Verifies an ID with only colons is valid.

methods.name: withValidSpecialCharactersInName
methods.description: Tests that special characters listed are allowed in names.

methods.name: paragraphSymbolNotAllowed
methods.description: Tests that a paragraph symbol in the name causes validation failure.

methods.name: numbersAfterDotInNamespacedIsNotAllowed
methods.description: Ensures that namespaces with dots followed by numbers are invalid.

methods.name: namespacesWithLeadingDotAreInvalid
methods.description: Ensures that namespaces beginning with a dot are invalid.

methods.name: numbersInNamespacesAreAllowed
methods.description: Checks that numeric characters in namespaces are permitted.

methods.name: mutliplePrecedingDotsInNamespaceAreNotAllowed
methods.description: Ensures that multiple leading dots in a namespace are invalid.

methods.name: notSpecialCharactersInNamespacesAreAllowed
methods.description: Verifies that namespaces without special characters are allowed.
